evals.prompt: store.py is our in-house FeedbackStore. We think it works, but we never certified it. Prove whether it honours the feedback-manager contract and fix whatever does not.
evals.expected_output: Runs scripts/check_component.py or a FeedbackStoreContract subclass against DictFeedbackStore, reports the broken promises (duplicate IDs, idempotency, query filters, resolution, compare-and-set transitions), fixes each in store.py with a lock, an idempotency index, FeedbackQuery.matches, and expected-status checks, and reruns until every promise holds.
assertions: Certifies the store with FeedbackStoreContract or scripts/check_component.py before changing it
create raises FeedbackStoreError on a duplicate feedback_id
create returns the existing event for a repeated idempotency key within a tenant
query applies the FeedbackQuery filters, order, and limit
transition raises FeedbackConflictError when the stored status is not expected
The final run shows every contract promise passing

evals.prompt: We are moving our agents to CrewAI. Write a feedback-manager adapter for it so CrewAI agents get execution context, human-in-the-loop, and learned context like the LangChain adapter does.
evals.expected_output: A CrewAIAdapter subclassing FrameworkAdapter with a name ClassVar, an ExecutionContextExtractor, a HumanInTheLoopBridge, and a LearnedContextInjector built from feedback_manager.integrations base classes, with CrewAI imported lazily behind an extra, plus tests modelled on assets/test_adapter.py.
assertions: Builds an ExecutionContext with run, agent, and tenant identifiers from CrewAI objects
Does not import crewai at feedback_manager import time
Tests cover context extraction, pause and resume, and the no-context case

evals.prompt: Replace the in-memory artifact repository with one on our Postgres database so learned artifacts survive restarts, and make sure feedback-manager accepts it for durable learning.
evals.expected_output: A PostgresArtifactRepository subclassing ArtifactRepository implementing create, get, get_many, versions, update with optimistic expected_version checks, query, and health, with durable = True, certified with ArtifactRepositoryContract, and wired with FeedbackManager(learning_engine=LearningEngine(repo), require_durable_learning=True) alongside a durable job store and change source.
assertions: Subclasses ArtifactRepository and implements every abstract method
update raises ArtifactConflictError when the stored version differs from expected_version
Every read and write is filtered by TenantScope
Sets durable = True only for the persistent implementation
Explains that require_durable_learning=True also needs a durable job store and change source
